name: v2.5.26-dev.1-alpha7
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26-dev.1-alpha7

- changer: DISC -/+ move to the album before or after in the queue
- changer: the disc in the drive turns at the CD scene's pace
- albums: Cover Flow and the CD changer, a button each in the crumb bar
- now playing: a look chosen from the remote wins over the changer's full screen
- changer: the drive seen straight from above, its disc as the CD scene's
- changer: a drive window where the disc is put on the lens and turns
- changer: keys and lettering large enough to read on the screen
- changer: discs really go into their slots, a Clear that empties it
- kiosk: a CD changer, as a Now Playing animation and as a view of the albums
- website: IndexNow key, so Bing and the others can be told when pages change
- website: robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt and structured data for search and AI
- website: the F-Droid index is not a download, only the APKs are counted

- website: the same client fetching the same file within an hour counts once
